title: Bee Removal in Brooklyn Heights
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Brooklyn Heights, Brooklyn. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Brooklyn Heights residents facing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, or ground bee nests need fast, professional treatment. The Best Pest Control NYC removes active nests from wall voids, chimneys, eaves, soffits, and structural wood throughout Brooklyn Heights — protecting your historic brownstone or modern apartment from stinging insects and the structural damage nests cause.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Brooklyn Heights for years, understanding the unique challenges of bee removal in this historic neighborhood's diverse architecture. Our licensed technicians use eco-friendly methods to safely relocate bees while protecting your family, pets, and the structural integrity of your brownstone or co-op building.
localContext: Brooklyn Heights' tree-lined streets, proximity to Brooklyn Bridge Park, and mix of 19th-century brownstones and pre-war buildings create ideal nesting conditions for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in chimneys, eaves, wall voids, and garden structures. Carpenter bees target the neighborhood's exposed wood trim, porch beams, and historic architectural details. The protected historic status of many properties requires careful nest treatment that preserves original masonry and woodwork while eliminating the colony and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Brooklyn Heights?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Brooklyn Heights?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove wasp and hornet nests in Brooklyn Heights?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service in Brooklyn Heights. Once you call (855) 930-5016, we can typically schedule treatment within hours. Most nest treatments and entry-point sealing are completed within 24–48 hours, depending on the nest location and access.

faqs.question: How do you treat nests in historic Brooklyn Heights brownstones without damaging the building?
faqs.answer: Our licensed technicians treat wasp and hornet nests through existing entry points — chimney flues, soffit gaps, mortar cracks — using targeted application of EPA-registered products. We remove accessible nest material, then seal every opening with materials matched to the building's original architecture. The approach protects masonry, woodwork, and historic details while eliminating the colony and preventing recolonization.
